children: Everus Construction Group entered into a First Amendment to its Credit Agreement to refinance and upsize its senior secured facilities. The amendment provides $477.5 million of term loans and $350.0 million of revolving commitments, led by JPMorgan, with improved pricing tied to leverage. Proceeds will refinance prior loans, fund the Epsilon Industries acquisition, cover related fees, and support working capital and general corporate purposes.
: Amendment to senior secured term loan and revolving credit facilities
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent and collateral agent, and other lenders
: Refinance debt, fund Epsilon acquisition, and add liquidity
